Summary: DeepSeek-V3.1 is a Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language model comprising 671 billion parameters with 37 billion activated per token. It was released on August 21, 2025, and supports context lengths up to 128K. The model is licensed under the MIT License and is available for download from Hugging Face and ModelScope. The architecture includes Multi-head Latent Attention and DeepSeekMoE for efficient inference and training.
